# Overview

<!-- This page is generated by scripts/generate-recipes.py from the recipes dataset. Do not edit it by hand. -->

Recipes are ready-to-deploy configurations for open models from the Hugging Face Hub on Amazon SageMaker AI. Each one pins the Hugging Face Deep Learning Container, the instance, and the engine settings, so you can deploy a model in one click from the AWS console or with one AWS CLI command. To deploy from Python, see [Deploy a model](./deploy-a-recipe). To learn how the numbers are collected, see [How deployments are benchmarked](./methodology).
